batch_Real: 81 then last50, every5153 Real window each epoch
K_sampling: 16 steps perK per64-step epoch, seeded shuffle; one shared field and D
Generator: frozen original C3 Dual-VAE + trainable original GRU base plus zero-init temporal correction field, h0=0
field: v=T_C3(zs)+corr(h,zs,t); one GRU base, one correction GRU, weights shared acrossK
prior_GMM: inherited via C3 GRU trained on original1200 physical statistical pseudo-pairs; NO new GMM or latent OT
teacher: original C3, train same-window outputs cached, loss only not deployed G0
C27: comparison only, not teacher or initialization
gradient: straight-through sigmoid surrogate for existing0-logit threshold, forward exactly originalMAP; no soft output used as fake
D: one full4x712 Mask+log1p channel-mixing MLP5696-192-64-1, no2D adjacency assumption
optimizer: Adam lr1e-4 betas(0,.99) for field and D
flow_penalty: normalized correction field magnitude in target-coordinate Train scale
lambda_teacher: 1 for firstGANepoch, linear decay to0 by sixthGANepoch
teacher_loss: mean squared log1p output difference / RealTrain logscale^2, no cross-domain sample MSE
preserve_loss: array-index patch response shares squared discrepancy + relative adjacent response-change discrepancy; not physical contact proof
checkpoint_rule: last fully completed epoch, no C0 selection, no hyperparameter search
